cases.SudoRoute_advice: Do not resend the same transfer: the cause has not been fixed yet.
cases.baseline_note: Money comes back, but a blind resend fails again for the same reason.

definitions.Bank wire: SWIFT wire from an authorised bank to the account printed on the invoice. Legal, no invoice check, ignores timing.
definitions.Cheapest-fee assistant: Licensed channels only; lowest cost; pays the account on the invoice; does not check country rules, university partner status, limits or arrival time; executes every request.
definitions.scams_that_reach_a_fraudster: Of 42 scam invoices, how many send money to an account that is not the university's verified one.
definitions.rule_violations: Of 160 payments, how many use a channel the home-country rules, the university or the channel limit do not allow.
definitions.late_rate_pct: Expected share of payments arriving after the real due date (channel delivery window and reliability).
definitions.avoidable_late_pct: Lateness that an allowed channel could have avoided. Some deadlines are too close for any allowed channel; SudoRoute warns about these early with a pay-by date.
definitions.overpayments_on_retry: Of 3 retry situations, how many end with the university paid more than the invoice.
definitions.why_assistant_cheaper: The assistant is cheaper and faster only because it uses channels the rules do not allow; SudoRoute chooses among allowed channels only.
definitions.note: SudoRoute sends genuine invoices flagged for a check to the student first; it never pays the account printed on an invoice.
